0022600038.text: The New Orleans Pelicans host the Memphis Grizzlies in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, with New Orleans at 4-7 and 12th in the West, 5 games behind for fifth in the Southwest after losing three straight, while Memphis is 7-3, third in the Southwest 1.5 games back, and has won its last game and is 5-0 on the road. The Pelicans are missing Bennedict Mathurin (thumb sprain), Trendon Watford (ankle sprain), Trey Murphy III (knee tendinitis), and Yves Missi (knee bruise), and the Grizzlies are without Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). New Orleans leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 135-134 win in Memphis on November 2, 2026, and the teams split their 2025-26 meetings 2-2.
